heard: A Saturn V rocket generated the lightning that struck it. Most assume Apollo 12 hit a random Florida storm. Actually, the massive rocket and its exhaust triggered the bolts. The first strike hit 36 seconds in, killing the power. A second strike turned mission data into total gibberish. Controller John Aaron recognized the failure from an obscure test. He ordered the crew to flip the SCE switch to auxiliary. Alan B did, restoring data and saving the mission. The crew survived because a Saturn V rocket generated the lightning that struck it.
